app.name: bankKhana
app.setupBody: Copy .env.example to .env, add your project URL and anon key, then restart the app.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHelp: Your sign-in email cannot be changed here.
profile.displayNameHelp: Shown to people who share accounts with you.
profile.changePasswordHelp: Enter your current password, then choose a new one.
profile.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.
profile.passwordChangeError: Could not change password. Try again.

offline.banner: You are offline. Viewing saved data. New expenses will sync when you reconnect.
offline.actionDisabled: Connect to the internet to use this
offline.needCache: Connect once online to load your data, then you can view it offline.
offline.pageUnavailable: This section needs a network connection for live prices or trading.

auth.forgotNeedEmail: Enter your email above, then tap Forgot.
auth.forgotOk: Check your email for a reset link.
auth.forgotError: Could not send reset email. Try again.
auth.resetSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.resetWaiting: Open the link from your email to continue…
auth.resetOk: Password updated. Taking you to the app…
auth.resetError: Could not update password. Request a new reset link.
auth.error: Could not sign in. Please check your credentials and try again.
auth.signupOk: Account created. Check your email if confirmation is required, then sign in.

expense.empty: No expenses yet. Add your first one.
expense.formHint: Amount, account, optional expense group, category, and date.
expense.fxHelp: Enter the amount in the currency you paid. It is converted to {{currency}} (account) with a live rate — you do not enter the account amount yourself.
expense.fxError: Could not fetch exchange rate. Try again.
expense.fxOffline: Connect to convert currencies. Or choose the account currency.

dashboard.tapDay: Tap a day to see the amount
dashboard.emptyChart: Add expenses in this period to see charts.
dashboard.wealthEmpty: Add accounts, gold, or stocks to see this chart.
dashboard.summaryHelp: Your money across accounts, gold, and stocks.

settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultCurrencyHelp: Dashboard totals use this currency. When you spend from another currency, enter what it equals in this one.
settings.installBody: Add bankKhana to your home screen. Offline you can view saved accounts and expenses, and queue new expenses to sync when you are back online.
settings.installIos: On iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
settings.installAndroid: On Android Chrome: open the menu, then Install app or Add to Home screen.

gold.title: Gold
gold.subtitle: Track grams by karat. Value uses your gram prices in Settings.
gold.buyHint: Pay from an account using your gram prices in Settings.
gold.avgCostHint: What you paid for 1 gram. Compared with the live gram price to show gain or loss.
gold.formHint: Record gold you already own. Enter average paid per gram to track gain or loss vs live price.
gold.priceUnavailable: Could not load gold prices from the API. Enter them manually.
gold.pricesHelp: Price per gram in {{currency}} for 24K, 21K, and 18K. Loaded from the market API; you can edit them.
gold.transferHint: Convert grams to money using your gram prices, then add it to an account.
gold.setPricesFirst: Set gold prices in Settings (or tap Refresh) to value holdings and sell to an account.
gold.insufficient: Not enough grams in this holding.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add a wallet, cash, or bank account.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.editHint: Change the name, currency, or balance.
accounts.insufficient: Not enough money in this account.
accounts.needAccountFirst: Create an account first, then add expenses from it.
accounts.addMoneyHint: Add to this account in its currency.
accounts.transferHint: Move money between accounts. Different currencies convert automatically.
accounts.confirmDeleteTransfer: Delete this transfer? Account balances will be reverted.
accounts.needTwoAccounts: Add a second account to transfer.
accounts.cannotDelete: This account has expenses. Delete those expenses first.
accounts.shareHint: Others can join with this code and add money or expenses.
accounts.creator: Creator
accounts.leaveConfirm: Leave this shared account? You will lose access until you join again.
accounts.joinHint: Enter the share code from the account owner.
accounts.joinError: Invalid share code. Check and try again.
accounts.detailHelp: Expenses and deposits for this account, including who made each one.
accounts.detailNotFound: Account not found or you no longer have access.
accounts.noDeposits: No deposits recorded yet. Use Add money to track who contributed.

expenseGroups.title: Expense groups
expenseGroups.empty: No expense groups yet. Create one and share the code with friends.
expenseGroups.name: Group name
expenseGroups.formHint: A shared list of expenses — not a bank account.
expenseGroups.shareHint: Others can join with this code and add expenses from their accounts.
expenseGroups.creator: Creator
expenseGroups.leaveConfirm: Leave this expense group? You will lose access until you join again.
expenseGroups.joinHint: Enter the share code from the group creator.
expenseGroups.joinError: Invalid share code. Check and try again.
expenseGroups.detailNotFound: Group not found or you no longer have access.
expenseGroups.confirmDelete: Delete this expense group? Expenses stay on the accounts that paid them.
expenseGroups.addExpenseHint: Paid from one of your accounts. The account balance is reduced.
expenseGroups.noExpenses: No expenses in this group yet.
expenseGroups.settleEnabledHelp: Equal split of group spend. Members who are owed can record money received into their accounts. Archive only after everyone is even.
expenseGroups.receiveMoneyHint: Record that someone paid you back, and add it to one of your accounts.
expenseGroups.receiveAmountTooHigh: Amount is higher than what is still owed.
expenseGroups.fullySettled: Everyone is even — you can archive this group.
expenseGroups.settlementOpen: Some members still owe or are owed money.
expenseGroups.archiveBlocked: Settle everyone first (receive money), then archive. Open the group to finish settlement.

stocks.title: Stocks
stocks.egyptHint: Egyptian prices come from the EGX feed (TradingView), in EGP — not Yahoo. Use COMI, HRHO, SWDY.
stocks.formHint: Ticker, how many shares you hold, and the average price you paid.
stocks.tradeHint: Uses the live market price, then converts to the account currency.
stocks.quoteUnavailable: Could not load a live price for this ticker. For Egypt use codes like COMI, HRHO, or COMI.CA.

landing.heroTitle: Track money, gold, stocks, and shared spending — with calm luxury.
landing.heroBody: bankKhana is your private ledger: accounts in any currency, expenses and groups, live gold and stock prices, and a dashboard that shows the whole picture — online or offline.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you already use in the app
landing.featuresSubtitle: Built for households that hold cash, metal, and markets — not just a simple expense list.
landing.featAccountsBody: Cash and bank wallets, add money, transfer between accounts, and convert currencies with your own rates.
landing.featExpensesBody: Log spending by category and account. Work offline — new expenses queue and sync when you are back online.
landing.featGroupsBody: Split trips, household bills, or projects. Invite others with a share code and keep one shared list.
landing.featGoldBody: Record grams and karats, follow live prices, and sell or move value back into an account.
landing.featStocksBody: Track Egyptian and global tickers with live quotes, buy and sell against your cash accounts.
landing.featDashboardBody: Month totals, charts, and a single view of cash plus investments — hide amounts when you need privacy.
landing.featShareBody: Invite family to a wallet. Everyone sees the same balance and history, with their own sign-in.
landing.featLocaleBody: Switch language and theme any time. Designed for RTL Arabic and a gold-and-navy look.
landing.servicesSubtitle: Practical tools for personal and family finance — not a bank, a private tracker you control.
landing.svcPersonalBody: See cash, gold, and stocks together so you know what you actually own.
landing.svcFamilyBody: Joint accounts and expense groups for households, travel, and shared projects.
landing.svcInvestBody: Live gold and market prices so holdings stay close to the real world.
landing.svcPrivacyBody: Your data lives in your cloud project. Hide amounts on screen when others are looking.
landing.finalTitle: Start with a quiet, complete money home.
landing.finalBody: Create an account in a minute. Your dashboard, wallets, and assets wait on the other side.
landing.footerCopy: bankKhana — accounts, gold, stocks, and expenses.
